sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Yayi Boni wins presidency
geopolitical_news.summary: The former banker defeats Adrien Houngbedji in March's runoff, ending Mathieu Kerekou's long rule.

geopolitical_news.headline: Peaceful transfer of power
geopolitical_news.summary: Kerekou steps aside gracefully, cementing Benin's democratic reputation.

sport.headline: Benin fall short in World Cup qualifying
sport.summary: The Squirrels miss out on Germany 2006 after a difficult qualifying campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pro-Yayi coalition wins legislative vote
geopolitical_news.summary: March's parliamentary elections give the president's allies a working majority.

geopolitical_news.headline: Anti-corruption drive launched
geopolitical_news.summary: Yayi Boni pledges to clean up customs and public procurement.

sport.headline: Benin qualify for 2008 AFCON
sport.summary: The Squirrels book a place at the Ghana tournament, only their second AFCON ever.

geopolitical_news.headline: Yayi Boni consolidates power
geopolitical_news.summary: The president pushes economic reforms while the opposition accuses him of authoritarian drift.

geopolitical_news.headline: Benin strengthens regional trade ties
geopolitical_news.summary: Cotonou port upgrades aim to capture transit trade with landlocked neighbors.

sport.headline: Benin exit AFCON winless
sport.summary: Three defeats at Ghana 2008 send the Squirrels home without a point.

geopolitical_news.headline: Benin weathers global financial crisis
geopolitical_news.summary: Cotton exports cushion the economy as the government maintains steady growth.

geopolitical_news.headline: Voter registration disputes emerge
geopolitical_news.summary: Opposition parties clash with the government over the electoral roll ahead of 2011.

sport.headline: Benin qualify for 2010 AFCON
sport.summary: Back-to-back qualifications mark the Squirrels' best-ever international run.

geopolitical_news.headline: Floods displace tens of thousands
geopolitical_news.summary: Exceptional rains in October flood Cotonou and the south, destroying homes and crops.

geopolitical_news.headline: Election preparations begin
geopolitical_news.summary: The electoral commission gears up for the 2011 presidential vote amid opposition distrust.

sport.headline: Benin exit AFCON at group stage
sport.summary: A draw with Mozambique is the only point from three games at Angola 2010.

geopolitical_news.headline: Yayi Boni re-elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: The incumbent wins March's first-round vote; the opposition rejects the result.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition cries foul
geopolitical_news.summary: Rival candidates allege fraud in the voter roll and call for protests.

sport.headline: Benin miss 2012 AFCON
sport.summary: The Squirrels fail to qualify for the Gabon-Equatorial Guinea tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Alleged poison plot against president
geopolitical_news.summary: Authorities claim a foiled October plot to poison Yayi Boni, implicating businessman Patrice Talon.

geopolitical_news.headline: Talon flees into exile
geopolitical_news.summary: The president's former ally escapes abroad as the poisoning affair deepens.

sport.headline: Benin chase 2014 World Cup place
sport.summary: The Squirrels stay in contention in a qualifying group with Algeria and Mali.

geopolitical_news.headline: President's feud with Talon deepens
geopolitical_news.summary: The exiled tycoon is sentenced in absentia as the rivalry dominates politics.

geopolitical_news.headline: Legislative elections repeatedly delayed
geopolitical_news.summary: Parliament extends its own term as the vote, due since 2011, is postponed.

sport.headline: Benin miss 2013 AFCON
sport.summary: The Squirrels fail to reach the South Africa tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Third-term speculation surrounds Yayi
geopolitical_news.summary: Fears grow that the president may seek to extend his rule beyond 2016.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cotton exports buoy economy
geopolitical_news.summary: Record cotton output supports growth despite political uncertainty.

sport.headline: Benin miss 2014 World Cup
sport.summary: The Squirrels fall short in qualifying for Brazil 2014.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition wins legislative elections
geopolitical_news.summary: April's vote delivers a rebuke to Yayi Boni ahead of the presidential race.

geopolitical_news.headline: Benin joins anti-Boko Haram force
geopolitical_news.summary: Cotonou pledges troops to the regional task force fighting the jihadists.

sport.headline: Benin miss 2015 AFCON
sport.summary: The Squirrels fail to qualify for the Equatorial Guinea tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Patrice Talon wins presidency
geopolitical_news.summary: The businessman defeats Prime Minister Lionel Zinsou in March's runoff.

geopolitical_news.headline: Peaceful transfer of power
geopolitical_news.summary: Yayi Boni steps down after a decade, and Talon is inaugurated in April.

sport.headline: Benin send small team to Rio Olympics
sport.summary: A handful of Beninese athletes compete at the Rio 2016 Games.

geopolitical_news.headline: Talon's constitutional reform fails
geopolitical_news.summary: Parliament rejects the president's reform package in April, a major political defeat.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition protests grow
geopolitical_news.summary: Critics accuse Talon of concentrating power and harassing rivals.

sport.headline: Benin miss 2017 AFCON
sport.summary: The Squirrels fail to reach the Gabon tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Talon consolidates power
geopolitical_news.summary: New party laws and court rulings squeeze the opposition ahead of 2019 elections.

geopolitical_news.headline: Benin-Niger border cooperation
geopolitical_news.summary: Cotonou deepens trade ties with Niamey despite regional tensions.

sport.headline: Benin miss 2018 World Cup
sport.summary: The Squirrels fall short in qualifying for Russia 2018.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition barred from legislative vote
geopolitical_news.summary: Only pro-Talon parties contest April's election after rivals are disqualified.

geopolitical_news.headline: Post-election violence erupts
geopolitical_news.summary: Protests and an internet shutdown follow the vote; security forces crack down in Cotonou.

sport.headline: Benin reach AFCON quarterfinals
sport.summary: A penalty shootout win over Morocco takes the Squirrels to a historic last-eight finish in Egypt.

geopolitical_news.headline: COVID-19 reaches Benin
geopolitical_news.summary: The pandemic prompts border closures and strains the health system.

geopolitical_news.headline: Talon pushes economic reforms
geopolitical_news.summary: The government advances its development program despite the global slowdown.

sport.headline: Football suspended by pandemic
sport.summary: Benin's leagues and qualifiers halt for months amid COVID-19.

geopolitical_news.headline: Talon re-elected amid boycott
geopolitical_news.summary: The president wins April's vote after key rivals are jailed or barred.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pre-election violence
geopolitical_news.summary: Clashes in opposition strongholds mar the campaign period.

sport.headline: Benin narrowly miss 2021 AFCON
sport.summary: A controversial final qualifier against Sierra Leone denies the Squirrels a place in Cameroon.

geopolitical_news.headline: Jihadist attacks spread south
geopolitical_news.summary: Al-Qaeda-linked fighters strike in the north near the Burkina Faso border.

geopolitical_news.headline: Government launches counter-terrorism drive
geopolitical_news.summary: Cotonou deploys troops to the W-Arly-Pendjari park complex.

sport.headline: Benin miss 2022 World Cup
sport.summary: The Squirrels fall short in qualifying for Qatar 2022.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition returns to parliament
geopolitical_news.summary: January's legislative vote, with rivals allowed to run, is won by pro-Talon parties.

geopolitical_news.headline: Northern insecurity persists
geopolitical_news.summary: Deadly ambushes continue in the departments bordering the Sahel.

sport.headline: Benin miss 2023 AFCON
sport.summary: The Squirrels fail to qualify for the Ivory Coast tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Alleged coup plot foiled
geopolitical_news.summary: September arrests, including of presidential ally Olivier Boko, follow claims of a plot.

geopolitical_news.headline: Benin-Niger border dispute
geopolitical_news.summary: Niamey's junta keeps the frontier closed, hurting Benin's port revenues.

sport.headline: Benin top World Cup qualifying group
sport.summary: Surprise wins put the Squirrels atop their 2026 World Cup qualifying group mid-campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Coup attempt thwarted in Cotonou
geopolitical_news.summary: Soldiers seizing state TV in December are quickly overpowered by loyalist forces.

geopolitical_news.headline: Jihadist violence continues in north
geopolitical_news.summary: Insurgent attacks persist along the Burkina Faso and Niger borders.

sport.headline: Benin qualify for 2025 AFCON
sport.summary: The Squirrels finish second in their group to reach the Morocco tournament.
